summary: No Applied Materials filing, release, rating change or China/export-rule item dated 29 or 30 October turned up; the SEC filing list shows nothing newer than 26 October. The chip selloff is a price move, and the capex read-through (Intel capex up strongly, big-four 2026 capex guides about unchanged at roughly 730 billion) sits inside the research scenarios, so the research target (12m) of 443.36 stands. I could not reopen the Intel and big-four primary sources myself (sec.gov blocked automated access), so that read-through rests on your check.

items.headline: Alphabet Q3: shares fell sharply on cash-flow and AI-return worries; 2026 capex guide reported at 195-205 billion, 2027 'to top 300 billion' per one aggregator
items.why: Single secondary source; the 300 billion 2027 figure conflicts with the check that no company gave a numeric 2027 number, so it is left unverified. Even if true, it is close to the 284.8 billion consensus for Alphabet used in the research, so it is inside scenarios.
